d:
Two Special Police Officers (SPOs), who went missing during an anti-terror operation in Kishtwar, were found dead with bullet wounds. The deaths came a day after terrorists opened fire at a CRPF checkpoint in Kulgam, injuring three personnel. The back-to-back incidents have triggered fresh concerns over the security situation in Jammu and Kashmir, with the BJP calling for stricter action and the Congress questioning the Centre's claims of normalcy.
Thank you for watching our video!
